CustomField.label: Industry Label
CustomField.description: Human-readable industry name derived from the Industry__c key.
CustomField.formula: IF(Industry__c = 'fintech', 'Financial Services', IF(Industry__c = 'medtech', 'MedTech', IF(Industry__c = 'lifesci', 'Life Sciences', IF(Industry__c = 'media', 'Media & Entertainment', IF(Industry__c = 'transport', 'Transportation & Logistics', IF(Industry__c = 'government', 'Government & Public Sector', IF(ISBLANK(Industry__c), '', Industry__c)))))))
